kind: Shipped Max adapter executed against a simulated Live Object Model

checks.name: Portable UI load, track discovery, self exclusion and selected-device follow
Left/Right/Both route 5/5/10 dimensions in original finger order
Both mode waits for both hands and rejects malformed replacement frames
Capture normalizes real Live ranges and ignores custom clamp scaling
Actual adapter training completes; Run drives native units and Stop releases
Output clamps and quantized targets respect chosen valid bounds
Input modes retain separate training banks, and switching mode releases mappings
Changing scope keeps the previous model bank and prevents stale row events
Following a new device stops control; clicking the utility itself retains the target
Manual target selection pins a same-track device and rejects another track
Selected track context follows current Live track and reuses cached API objects
Deleted or moved targets release all remotes before another prediction
Deleted device is rejected by commands; changed parameter list refreshes safely
Unavailable parameters cannot be scoped or captured
Failure on a later output releases any earlier remote assignments
Samples and neural weights restore after ID changes, with Run always off
Legacy 10-output import uses original weights and requires exact scope count
Adding an example invalidates the current model; undo and clear affect only that bank
Deletion cancels scheduled work and releases remote channels
Large parameter tables and saved samples use bounded fragments and restore intact
Live theme bridge accepts native colors and rejects unknown or malformed messages
